blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.
blocks.zh: 深层研究剂(DRA)通常用于开放式的合成任务,其中闭合世界质量评估基准不适合描述性能的相关方面. 我们研究一个商业深层研究系统的自我一致性, 重复同样的提示, 代表每个报告与它提到的一组命名的实体, 分类为定制计划, 通过重复运行一个与网络安全有关的单一无限制的快件,我们用成对重叠进行量化,以说明在重复的相同快件下检索和合成的产出结构的稳定性。 在10跑中,对等实体Jaccard的中位数为0.12,对等引号Jaccard低于0.02,发现曲线不明显饱和. 实体组合之间(dis)协议的大小和结构因实体类别而异,这表明在DRA中自我一致性被更好的理解为基础实体空间的函数而不是系统的稳定属性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 导言和有关工作

blocks.en:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is an umbrella term for methods designed to inject external knowledge into the context of a large language model at runtime, with the goal of providing more accurate, grounded, or updated information to improve the reliability and transparency of the answers it generates.
As suggested by the acronym, it has three main components: Retrieval of data from external sources, Augmenting the current query context with the most relevant information, and Generating an answer that combines the Large Language Model’s (LLM’s) pre-trained knowledge with the retrieved information.
blocks.zh:
Retrival-Augmented Generation(RAG)是一个伞式术语,用于设计在运行时将外部知识注入大型语言模型背景的方法,目标是提供更准确,基于,或更新的信息,以提高其生成的答案的可靠性和透明度.
如缩略语所示,它包括三个主要部分: 从外部来源获取数据,用最相关的信息增强当前查询上下文,并生成一个将大语言模型(LLM)预先培训的知识与检索到的信息相结合的答案.

blocks.en:
Singh et al. (2025) suggest a taxonomy of RAG ranging from a simple keyword-based Naïve RAG through to more advanced Agentic RAG systems, known as deep research agents (DRAs) that can autonomously examine hundreds of online sources per query and produce long-form reports with citations in response to arbitrary requests.
Recent surveys characterise four core stages in the deep research pipeline, i.e. planning, question development, web exploration, and report generation, each of which admits substantial design variation across commercial implementations ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
Singh等人(2025年)建议对RAG进行分类,从简单的基于关键词的Naïve RAG到更先进的Agentic RAG系统,称为深层研究代理(DRAs),每一次查询可以自主地审查数百个在线来源,并生成长式报告,同时根据任意请求引用.
近期调查定性为深层研究管道的四个核心阶段,即规划,问题开发,网络探索,以及报告生成,每个阶段都承认在商业实施上存在实质性的设计差异(张等,2025年).

blocks.en:
Existing evaluations of deep research agents often emphasize claim-level factual accuracy, leaving aspects such as their handling of multi-source synthesis and the structural properties of the knowledge these systems produce less examined ( Huang et al., 2025 ) .
Because the outputs are long-form and open-ended, being based on a web-scale retrieval step rather than a fixed corpus, their real-world usage is poorly characterized by the closed-world QA style benchmarks.
More recent evaluations have developed approaches such as decomposing reports into atomic facts ( Min et al., 2023 ) and using metrics such as recall and relevance in addition to binary correctness ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
对深层研究物剂的现有评价往往强调权利要求层面的事实准确性,留下诸如处理多源合成和这些系统所产生的知识的结构特性等方面(Huang等人,2025年)。
由于产出是长式的和开放式的,基于网络尺度的检索步骤,而不是固定的元件,因此其真实世界的用法与封闭世界QA风格基准的特征差.
较近期的评价已经制定了一些办法,如将报告分解为原子事实(Min等人,2023年),除了二进制正确性外,还采用诸如召回和相关性等衡量标准(Gupta等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Large language models are inherently stochastic, and due to their autoregressive nature, the effects of small perturbations in their outputs compound over the sequences generated. Zhai et al. (2026) model the stochasticity of answers, findings, and citations in DRA using Markov information acquisition decision processes. Most prior treatments of DRA stochasticity focus on variability in answers or final claims, but the structural question of how stable the set of retrieved and synthesized referents is across repeated runs has received comparatively little attention.
Another line of work evaluates long-form generation by decomposing outputs into discrete units (atomic facts, claims, or named entities) and reasoning about coverage and overlap at that level rather than at the level of full text ( Min et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型具有内在的曲折性,由于它们的自旋性,其输出中小扰动的影响复合了产生的序列. Zhai等人(2026年)利用Markov信息获取决策程序,在DRA中模拟答案、调查结果和引用的花样。 以往对DRA的处理大多侧重于答案或最终索赔的可变性,但关于被检索和合成的推荐词集在反复运行中是否稳定的结构性问题相对较少受到关注。
另一类工作通过将产出分解成离散单位(原子事实、索赔或被命名的实体)来评价长式生成,并在这一层面而不是在全文层面对覆盖范围和重叠进行推理(Min等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Next, the stability of DRA under repeated prompting and decomposition of its output into discrete units is presented as the following research questions:
blocks.zh: 其次,DRA在输出被反复催化和分解成离散单元的情况下的稳定性作为下列研究问题提出:

blocks.en:
• How consistent is a deep research system’s entity coverage across repeated runs of the same prompt? • How consistent is its set of cited sources across repeated runs? • How consistent is the joint structure of which entities are grounded in which sources across repeated runs? Our approach contributes to addressing a gap in long-form LLM evaluation by examining how stable a single system’s retrieved and synthesized outputs, operationalized through entity extraction, are under repeated identical prompting, rather than whether individual statements are verifiably factually correct.
The contributions presented here are threefold. First, we propose a three-level representation of DRA outputs, i.e.
canonicalized named entities, citations, and entity–citation pairs,
as an evaluation lens for self-consistency under repeated identical prompting.
Second, applying this lens to a single commercial DRA on an open-ended topical cybersecurity related prompt, we show that entity-level agreement is substantially higher than citation-level agreement.
Third, we show that pairwise agreement varies sharply across entity classes in a way that tracks the presumed size of the underlying entity space.
blocks.zh:
• 支助 一个深层研究系统的实体对同一时间的反复覆盖有多一致? • 一再引用的资料来源是否一致? 有多少共同结构是建立在哪些实体的基础之上的? 我们的方法有助于解决长式LLM评价中的空白,方法是审查通过实体提取而运行的单一系统检索和综合产出是如何稳定的,而不是个别声明是否在事实上可以核查。
本文提供的材料有三重。 首先,我们提议由三个级别代表达尔富尔地区管理局的产出,即:
名称化的实体、引文和实体-引文对
在重复相同的提示下,作为自我一致性的评价透镜。
第二,在与网络安全有关的无限制主题下,将这一镜头应用于一个单一的商业DRA,我们显示,实体一级的协议大大高于引用一级的协议。
第三,我们显示,各实体之间的对等协议差异很大,其方式可以跟踪基本实体空间的假定大小。

blocks.en: How consistent is a deep research system’s entity coverage across repeated runs of the same prompt?
blocks.zh: 一个深层研究系统的实体在同一个瞬间反复展开时的覆盖程度如何一致?

blocks.en: How consistent is its set of cited sources across repeated runs?
blocks.zh: 其重复引用的资料来源有多一致?

blocks.en: How consistent is the joint structure of which entities are grounded in which sources across repeated runs?
blocks.zh: 有多少共同结构是建立在哪些实体的基础之上的?

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
To study the self-consistency of a deep research system under fixed user inputs, we issue an identical open-ended cybersecurity prompt to a single commercial deep research system (Google deep-research-preview-04-2026 , accessed through the API on 2026-04-27) in 10 10 repeated iterations of the same prompt, shown in Figure 1 .
Each of the ten runs produced a main report with links to citations.
Inline citations in the raw response were emitted by the agent as a redirect URL. These URLs are followed by
an HTTP GET request with a Chrome-like User-Agent and the resolved URL is recorded.
These raw reports and cited sources are cleaned with a deterministic preprocessing pipeline before extraction. Resolved citation URLs were retained as citation identifiers, but the content of cited web pages was not included in the entity-overlap analysis.
blocks.zh:
为了研究在固定用户输入下深层研究系统的自我一致性,我们发布了一个相同的开放式网络安全即时到一个单一的商业深层研究系统(Google Deep-research-preview-04-2026,通过API于2026-04-27访问),在10个重复的相同即时重复,如图1所示.
这10次调查中,每一次都编写了一份主要报告,与引文链接。
原始回复中的内在引用被代理作为重定向URL发布. 这些 URL 后面是
一个带有类似 Chrome 的用户代理的 HTTP GET 请求, 并记录解析的 URL 。
这些原始报告和引述的来源在开采前用确定性预处理管道清理。 已解析引用的URL被保留为引用标识符,但引用的网页内容没有纳入实体重叠分析.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Analysis pipeline . We query Google Deep Research ten times with the same cybersecurity-related prompt and treat each generated report as one run. For each run, we extract entities and citation URLs using langextract, canonicalize entity strings by class using a three-way voting procedure with gabriel, and compute pairwise Jaccard similarities and discovery curves over the resulting canonical entity and citation sets.
blocks.zh: 图1:分析管道 我们以同样的网络安全相关快捷方式查询Google Deep Research十次, 对于每次运行,我们使用langextract来提取实体和引用的URL,用加布里埃尔的三向投票程序将实体字符串逐个分类化,并在由此产生的犬类实体和引用集上计算成对的Jaccard相似性和发现曲线.

blocks.en:
Entities were extracted from all preprocessed documents using the langextract library 1 1 1 langextract is not an officially supported Google product. with Google Gemini 2.5-flash as the extraction model ( Google, 2025 ) .
Raw entity surface forms were canonicalized using the openai-gabriel library, a general-purpose information extraction library that has been described and validated in Asirvatham et al. (2026) .
Deduplication was run separately for each of the eleven entity classes.
blocks.zh:
实体是从所有预处理文件中提取的,使用langextract库 1 1 langextract并不是官方支持的Google产品. Google双子座2.5-flash作为提取模型(Google,2025).
原始实体表面表单通过Openai-gabriel图书馆进行分类,这是一个通用信息提取图书馆,在Asirvatham等人(2026年)中已有描述和验证。
11个实体类别中的每个类别都分别进行重复。

blocks.en:
The method operates in two stages: first, embedding-based grouping clusters similar surface forms into groups of up to 500 that are then assigned labels in-context.
The model used was gpt-5.4-mini .
The process was repeated three times ( n_runs=3 ) with voting to reduce the effect of random noise.
The system prompt used was the default one provided with the package.
blocks.zh:
该方法分两个阶段运作:第一,嵌入基于组的类似表面形态的组为最多500个组,然后被分配到内置的标签.
使用的型号是gpt-5.4-mini.
该过程经过三次重复(n_runs=3),并有表决,以减少随机噪声的影响.
使用的系统提示是提供包的默认提示。

Given a fixed reading order π = ( d 1 , … , d n ) \pi=(d_{1},\dots,d_{n}) of the n n runs and a per-document item set X d X_{d} , the discovery curve is as follows:

C π ( k ) = | ⋃ i = 1 k X d i | , k = 1 , … , n , C_{\pi}(k)=\left|\bigcup_{i=1}^{k}X_{d_{i}}\right|,\quad k=1,\dots,n, i.e. the cumulative count of distinct items (entities or citations) seen after reading the first k k documents.
To reduce dependence on an arbitrary run ordering, we compute this curve over 1000 random permutations of the ten runs and report the mean accumulation curve in Figure 3 .
Flattening curves indicate that repeated runs are converging on a stable set; curves that remain steep indicate that each additional run keeps retrieving unseen entities.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Across the 10 runs, outputs contained a median of 5,292 words (range: 4,837–6,152), 199 extracted entity mentions (162–271), 162 distinct canonical entities after deduplication (139–193), 2.96 entities per 100 words (2.42–3.64), and 79 distinct citation URLs (66–101).
blocks.zh: 在整个10个作业中,产出的中位数为5 292个字(范围:4 837-6 152个),199个抽取的实体提到(162-271个),162个在重复后有区别的峡谷实体(139-193个),每100个字2.96个实体(2.42-3.64个),79个不同的引用URL(66-101个)。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows the distribution of pairwise Jaccard similarities across all 45 run pairs, broken down by entity class as well as aggregated for the overall entity set and for cited sources.
Agreement between any two runs is low in absolute terms: the overall entity Jaccard has a median of 0.12 0.12 , meaning that any two reports share only about one canonical entity in eight, despite being responses to an identical prompt.
Overlap of citations is even lower, with the median Jaccard similarity score between sets of citations in two reports being just over 0.01 0.01 , indicating that repeated runs of the same query rarely cite the same URLs.
We additionally computed pairwise Jaccard similarity over entity–citation edges, where an edge is treated as shared only when both the canonical entity and the resolved citation URL most closely following it match across two runs.
Edge-level agreement was near zero: across the 45 run pairs, the median edge Jaccard was 0.0073, with an interquartile range of 0.0019–0.0124 and a maximum of 0.0256. The median pair of runs shared only four entity–citation edges out of a union of 678.
We therefore do not plot edge overlap separately in Figure 2 , as it would be visually indistinguishable from the citation row.
Substantively, the result indicates that repeated runs do not stably reproduce the same URL-level grounding structure.
blocks.zh:
图2显示所有45个运行对子的双向Jacard相似性分布情况,按实体类别分列,并按整体实体和引用来源汇总。
任何两次运行之间的协议绝对值较低:整体实体Jaccard的中位数为0.12 0.12,这意味着任何两次报告在八次运行中只分享大约一个犬科实体,尽管是对一个相同的即时反应。
引用的重叠率甚至更低,两份报告中两组引用之间的中位数Jaccard相似性得分刚刚超过0.01 0.01,这表明同一查询的重复运行很少引用相同的URL.
我们还在实体引用边缘上计算成对的Jacard相似性,只有在条形实体和解析的引用URL最紧密地与两条线相匹配时,才将边缘视为共享。
边平面协议接近零:在45对跑线上,中间边角Jaccard为0.0073,跨度范围为0.0019–0.0124,最高为0.0256. 在678个联盟中,中位数对运行只分享四个实体的引用边。
因此,我们并不在图2中将边缘相重叠,因为它与引用行相去甚远。
实质上,结果显示,重复运行不会稳定地复制相同的URL级地面结构.

blocks.en:
Per-class Jaccard ranges over more than an order of magnitude, with Geopolitical actors and threat actors showing the highest median agreement, consistent with their being drawn from small, well-known closed vocabularies.
Security products, software targets, and cybersecurity techniques cluster near zero, which is consistent with their being drawn from large open vocabularies with long tails.
The overall entity row sits between these extremes and is dominated, in aggregate, by the long-tailed classes that contribute the most distinct items per run.
blocks.zh:
每个阶级的Jaccard的幅度超过一个数量级,地缘政治行为者和威胁行为者表现出最高的中位一致,这与他们从小型的、众所周知的封闭词汇中提取的一致。
安全产品,软件目标,网络安全技术集群接近零,这与它们从长尾的大型开放式词汇中抽取一致.
整个实体行位于这些极端之间,总体上由长尾班主导,这些班次每跑贡献最独特的项目。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Pairwise Jaccard similarity across ten repeated runs. Each point represents one unordered pair of reports, for 45 run pairs in total. Rows show Jaccard similarity over canonical entities within each class, resolved citation URLs, and the overall canonical entity set. Boxplots summarize the distribution across run pairs. Overall entity overlap is low, with median Jaccard approximately 0.12, while citation overlap is much lower, with median citation Jaccard just over 0.01. Entity–citation edge overlap is omitted from the plot because its median Jaccard is similarly near zero and visually indistinguishable from the citation row.
blocks.zh: 图 2:Pairwise Jaccard在10次重复运行中的相似性. 每点代表一对无序的报告,共45对运行. 各行显示Jaccard在每类中相对于犬科实体的相似性,解析引用 URL,以及整体犬科实体设置. Boxplotes总结了运行对子的分布. 整体实体重叠率较低,中位数Jaccard约为0.12,而引用重叠率则低得多,中位数引用数Jaccard刚刚超过0.01. 实体 - 引用边缘重叠从图中省略,因为它的中位数Jaccard 类似接近0,与引用行的视觉无法区分.

blocks.en:
As an alternative way to visualize the diverging pattern of entity coverage, Figure 3 shows the discovery curves for the entity classes.
Most curves appear approximately linear over the range we observe, with no visible inflection by the tenth run, with the exception of the categories Threat actor and Geopolitical actor.
blocks.zh:
作为可视化实体覆盖的不同模式的另一种方式,图3显示了实体类的发现曲线.
除了威胁演员和地缘政治演员的类别之外,大多数曲线都出现在我们观察到的线性范围内,第10次运行时没有明显的缺陷。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Discovery curves for canonical entity coverage across repeated runs. For each entity class, we randomly order the ten reports and compute the cumulative proportion of distinct canonical entities observed after k k runs. Curves that flatten quickly would indicate convergence towards a stable observed entity set; the mostly near-linear curves indicate that additional runs continue to surface previously unseen entities.
blocks.zh: 图3:反复运行的犬科实体覆盖的发现曲线。 对于每个实体类别,我们随机排列10份报告,并计算在k k 运行后观察到的不同犬科实体的累积比例。 快速平整的曲线将表明趋同到一个稳定的观测实体集;大多数接近线性的曲线表明,更多的运行继续浮出先前未见的实体。

blocks.en: 4 Concluding remarks
blocks.zh: 页:1 结论意见

blocks.en:
Our experiment shows that a single commercial deep research agent, queried ten times with an identical prompt, produces reports with low but structured overlap.
The median overall entity Jaccard between runs is approximately 0.12 0.12 , the median citation Jaccard is just over 0.01 0.01 and the median entity–citation edge overlap lower still, with a median Jaccard of 0.0073 0.0073 .
The discovery curves do not visibly saturate within ten runs, indicating that additional runs continue to surface previously unseen entities.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验显示,一个商业深层研究代理商,用同样的瞬间询问了10次,生成的报告虽然很少,但结构上重叠。
运行之间的中位整体实体Jaccard约为0.12 0.12,中位引号Jaccard刚刚超过0.01 0.01,中位实体-引号边缘重叠更低,中位数Jaccard为0.0073 0.0073。
发现曲线在10个运行中不明显饱和,表明额外的运行继续浮出以前未见的实体.

blocks.en:
The central finding is an asymmetry between referents and sources.
Repeated runs are more likely to mention the same organizations, geopolitical actors, threat actors, or AI models than they are to cite the same URLs in support of those mentions.
This suggests that the system has some stability in what it treats as topically relevant, but much less stability in the source trail through which those topics are retrieved and presented.
blocks.zh:
中心发现是参考词和来源之间的不对称.
重复运行更可能提到同样的组织、地缘政治行为者、威胁行为者或AI模式,而不是引用同样的URL来支持这些提及。
这表明,该系统将哪些内容视为与专题相关,具有一定稳定性,但检索和介绍这些专题的源线索稳定性要低得多。

blocks.en:
The research question related to entity–citation edges resolves negatively.
Exact edge agreement requires two runs to reproduce both the same canonical entity and the same resolved citation URL in support of it.
Because citation overlap is already extremely low, the resulting edge overlap is also near zero.
blocks.zh:
与实体引用边缘有关的研究问题解决了消极的。
精确边缘协议需要两个运行来复制相同的犬科实体和相同的解析引用URL以支持它.
由于引用重叠已经极低,由此产生的边缘重叠也接近零.

blocks.en:
Finally, consistency is strongly class-dependent.
Geopolitical actors and threat actors show the highest pairwise agreement, while security products, software targets, and cybersecurity techniques cluster near zero.
This is consistent with the hypothesis that classes drawn from relatively bounded vocabularies are more stable than classes drawn from large, open-ended technical vocabularies.
Self-consistency is therefore not a single number that characterizes a DRA in isolation, but the result of an interaction among the system, the prompt, the domain, and the entity class being measured.
blocks.zh:
最后,一致性在很大程度上取决于阶级。
地缘政治行为者和威胁行为者表现出最高的对等一致,而安全产品、软件目标和网络安全技术集群接近零。
这符合一种假设,即从相对界限的词汇中提取的分类比从大型的,开放式的技术词汇中提取的分类更为稳定.
因此,自我一致性并不是一个单独DRA的特征,而是系统,即时,域和被测量的实体类之间相互作用的结果.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations impact the claims of this work.
blocks.zh: 一些限制影响到这项工作的主张。

blocks.en: We study one commercial DRA on one prompt in one domain. We make no claim that the magnitudes reported here generalize to other DRAs, other prompts, or other domains. Cybersecurity was chosen due to a hypothesis that it would produce a mix of relatively stable named entities and rapidly evolving long-tail entities, but other domains might show different patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个领域研究一个商业DRA 我们没有声称,这里报告的规模将概括到其他达尔富尔地区报告、其他提示或其他领域。 选择网络安全是因为一种假设,即它将产生一种相对稳定的命名实体和迅速演变的长尾实体的组合,但其他领域可能显示出不同的模式。

blocks.en: Our experimental design does not separate variance arising from different web pages being retrieved across runs from variance arising from the same retrieved evidence being summarized differently due to limitations of the commercial API.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验设计并未将不同网页检索所产生的差异与同一检索证据所产生的差异区分开来,由于商业API的局限性,这些证据的汇总方式不同。

blocks.en: All ten runs were conducted within a short time window, but we cannot rule out that some inter-run variance reflects genuine changes in the indexed web rather than stochasticity of the agent. Because entity–citation edge equality depends on exact resolved URL matches, the edge results should be interpreted as URL-level grounding stability rather than semantic evidence stability. Two different URLs may support similar claims, and the same underlying source may sometimes be reachable through different URL forms.
blocks.zh: 所有10次运行都是在一个短时间窗口内进行的,但我们不能排除一些运行间的差异反映了索引网络的真实变化,而不是代理的花样变化. 因为实体-引用边缘平等取决于准确解析的URL匹配,所以边缘结果应该被解释为URL级的地基稳定性而不是语义证据稳定性. 两个不同的URL可能支持类似的主张,同一个基础来源有时可能通过不同的URL形式达到.

blocks.en: Our pipeline relies on LLM-based entity extraction and deduplication stages. We did not conduct a full annotation-quality audit of either stage. Spot checks suggest minor inconsistencies in granularity, for example whether versioned variants of the same model are merged into a single canonical entity or retained separately. This was likely a result of underspecified prompts to the deduplication software library. Such errors likely affect the exact numeric Jaccard values, especially for entity classes with many near-duplicate technical names but we do not have evidence that they would explain the overall patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们的管道依赖于基于LLM的实体提取和分解阶段。 我们没有就这两个阶段进行全面的注释质量审计。 抽查显示颗粒性有小的不一致之处,例如,同一个模型的版本变体是合并成一个单一的犬科实体还是单独保留. 这很可能是由于未对软件库进行详细描述。 这种错误可能影响准确的数值Jaccard值,特别是对于技术名称几乎重复的实体类别,但我们没有证据表明它们会解释总体模式。
